correctness.rationale: PASS. For commuting affine idempotents f_i, the idempotent product P fixes P(0) under each f_i, establishing a common fixed point without assuming one. Translating it to zero gives commuting linear projections A_i and orthogonal Boolean idempotents E_sigma whose images form a unique labelled direct-sum decomposition. The common fixed subspace is V_(1,...,1), so affine shifts contribute exactly q^(n-a_1) and stabilizer q^(a_1)*product(GL_(a_sigma)). For fixed q,k, log_q of each weight is (1-1/2^k)(n^2+n)-sum(delta_sigma^2)-delta_1; GL product factors have uniform finite bounds, and a summable discrete Gaussian majorant on the zero-sum deviation lattice proves the stated theta asymptotic and total-variation convergence via dominated convergence. Taking the ratio to k independent single-retraction counts gives gamma_k=k/2-1+2^-k. Independent direct function-table enumeration for F_2^2 recovered 17 idempotent affine maps, 121 ordered commuting pairs, and 617 ordered commuting triples. These finite cases corroborate, but do not prove, the fixed-arity limiting theorem; extension-field and further finite checks in repository were read but not treated as independent proof.
